35:
In this chapter we will explain that the sawing of Eve out of Adam is not the [same] subject as the diminution [of the moon], as the sawing was profitable for the coupling [of Adam and Eve] and for the procreation, which is not so for the diminution. And there is no place [here] to ask when it is was thus, how the procreation was before the sawing, or why they were created in such a way that they needed the sawing, because this subject has been explained in the Zohar and we have copied it in the Gate of Whatness and Guidance in Chapter 18. But perhaps the investigator thinks to oppose this [interpretation] by force of the words of the Rashbi in Parashat Achrei [Mot, folio] 77b [= Zohar Achrei Mot 62], and this is what it says:
“It was taught that upper He (ה = Binah) had become impregnated with love, with affection, therefore Yud (י = Chochmah) was never separated from her [= He]; she had become impregnated and brought forth Wav (ו = Tif’eret), afterwards he [= Wav] stands before her [= He], and she suckles him; and this Wav, when he came forth, his consort [= He] came forth with him.
Kindness/Chesed came, was aroused with him [= Wav], and [Chesed] separated them, and trunks came forth from below upwards, and branches were stretched out and spread out, and lower He (ה = Malkut) was formed.
And she [= lower He] grew with her branches upwards and upwards until she was coupled with the upper tree, and Wav united with He. Who brought this about? “It is Kindness/Chesed” [Leviticus 20:17]; verily it is Chesed who unites them as one. Yud with upper He, their uniting does not depend on Chesed, but on the Mazzal their uniting and their affection depend, [they] who are never separated. Yud is joined to He, He is joined to Wav, Wav is joined to He, and He is joined to the whole, and the whole is one junction and one word. They are never separated from each other.” End of citation.
